subject: general
question: 'The official language of the Union shall be Hindi in Devanagari script' is prescribed in which Article of the Indian Constitution?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Article 343__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 343** of the** Indian Constitution** stipulates that** Hindi** written in** Devanagari script** should be the **Union's official language.**
 
• The **Devanagari script **of** Hindi** is designated as the **official language** of the **Union under Article 343 (1)** of the Constitution.
 
• The use of **English in official Union** business may continue for a further **15 years (i.e., until January 25, 1965)** following the Constitution's start date, according to **Article 343 (2).**
 
• **English **will still be used for** official purposes** even after **January 25, 1965,** according to **Article 343(3)** of the Constitution.
 
• For a number of predetermined purposes, such as Resolutions, General Orders, Rules, Notifications, Administrative and Other Reports, Press Communiqués, Administrative and Other Reports and Official Papers to be Presented Before a House or the Houses of Parliament, Contracts, Agreements, Licensing and Permits, Tender Notices and Forms of Tender, etc., both Hindi and English must be used in accordance with Section 3(3) of the Act.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Article 345**

 
 
• ​The legislature of a state may select "any one or more of the languages in use in the State or Hindi as the language or languages to be used for all or any of the official purposes" of the concerned State, as per **Article 345 of the Constitution.**
 
 
 
• **Article 342**
 
 
• ​The provisions relating to **Scheduled Tribes are covered by Article 342.** It states that the President may specify the tribes or tribal communities, or portions of or groups within tribes or tribal communities, which shall, for the purposes of this constitution, deemed to be scheduled tribes in relation to that State or Union Territory, as the case may be, after consulting with the Governor thereof by public notification.
 
 
 
• **Article 343**
 
 
• ​The official language of the **Union** will be **Hindi in Devanagari script. Indian** numerals in their international format must be utilised for all official purposes by the Union.
